paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: The bar chart titled "Evaluation of ChatGPT VS various algorithms" illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools: VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT. The horizontal axis lists the three algorithms in the order VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT, while the vertical axis represents accuracy on a linear scale ranging from 0.4 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Each algorithm is represented by a distinct bar: VADER is shown as a solid white bar with a black outline, TextBlob as a white bar with diagonal black stripes, and ChatGPT as a solid green bar. The accuracy values are approximately 0.7 for VADER, 0.65 for TextBlob, and 0.9 for ChatGPT, with the green bar for ChatGPT being the tallest, indicating the highest accuracy. The chart includes a legend on the right side that matches each algorithm to its corresponding bar style and color. The bars are arranged in a left-to-right sequence corresponding to the algorithm labels, and no specific sorting order (e.g., descending) is applied. There are no additional visual annotations or emphasis on any particular bar.
